objective: Preallocate join stage-projection predicate column extraction sets from schema size.

tasks.title: Preallocate join stage projection predicate columns
tasks.result: Join stage projection now preallocates pending-predicate column extraction sets from the active schema width.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
Pending predicate column extraction in build_stage_join_projection now uses schema.columns.len() as its capacity hint.
Projection membership and required index selection behavior are unchanged.
